decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a multi-model dental consumable close to the firm's core materials business, so after several years on the market they are more likely to stay than to be discontinued.

The PETG thermoforming blank fits the firm's established dental laboratory workflow offering and benefits from the company's materials and production strengths, making retention the more likely choice.
The intraoral contrast spray supports digital dental workflows but is somewhat more specialized than core blanks and sheets, so it carries a moderate but still minority withdrawal risk.
Custom earmolds align well with the firm's hearing-care manufacturing capabilities and international specialist-channel business, so they remain strategically sensible to keep.

Custom hearing protection earmolds use the same custom-production base as the hearing segment but are a more niche adjacent line, so they face the highest rationalization risk while still being worth keeping for now.
